what: Today's lead tooling, serving both versions, prepares the shared-group checker for changed-proof slot rotation. This slice changes only the guard and its tests, plus this record and the plan. The current producer and scheduled workflow remain unchanged.
cause: Proof admission runs the trusted local checker against exact-head workflow text. A producer using the new group form cannot use its own candidate checker to approve that form. The checker must land first.
fix: Accept the legacy direct group or the exact closed identity lookup over groups 1 to 9, with a group-1 fallback and exact workflow run-number and output wiring. Unknown output uses conservative serialization rather than successful validation. A later producer slice must reject invalid run numbers before writing output.
test: Independent generated laws cover legacy and new forms, every full-map permutation, and rejection of missing, duplicate, private and out-of-range groups. Deliberately accepting an unbounded lookup or ignoring the wiring made the laws fail, then exact source bytes were restored. The producer slice and actual wait comparison remain open.
